newsitem.title: JAPAN: THAI CENTRAL BANK CHIEF TO MEET BOJ'S MATSUSHITA.
newsitem.headline: THAI CENTRAL BANK CHIEF TO MEET BOJ'S MATSUSHITA.

text.p: Thai central bank Governor Chaiyawat Wibulswasdi will meet Bank of Japan (BOJ) Governor Yasuo Matsushita around midday on Tuesday, a BOJ spokesman said.

Chaiyawat, along with Thai Finance Minister Thanong Bidaya, took part on Monday in a donors' meeting in Tokyo at which the international community, led by the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and Japan, pledged a $16 billion rescue package to ease Bangkok's financial crisis. Thanong is set to meet private Japanese banks later in the day to ask for their support, including the rollover of existing loans.
